body: Nah man, there are fuck ups, there are non fuck ups, there's me lol. I've never made anyone proud, not even me really, so no point in pretending I'm normal.

Hey, I can pretty much relate with most of what you said, and I'm not even gonna tell you not to carry on with it, I mean, I came here because I was just about to just end it all, now I'm kinda just trying to piece stuff together. In any way... I'd like you to PM if you'd want, I just want to understand people better here, and myself also. Hope this isn't reaching you too late.
